name: 370-festival
notes: #370 C3.d: the festival, from the game's plan and beats. Everyone brings a log or a basket to the fire and sets it down at their place in the ring; the leader throws a log on the fire (the hit: the fire flares); the speech, everyone sitting to listen; the whole camp dances in a ring round the fire (in step on purpose, B2.e); they eat; they all jump at once (the end beat, in step on purpose).
